failures.finding: comparison_evidence preserves summaries and artifact references but has no field for the exact anonymous outputs and reveal mapping. A cold reader receiving only the receipt would have to trust the assembler's narration rather than inspect the pair.

pressure_accountability has one pressure_id and cannot separately preserve the frozen expected ID, returned consumer ID, identity match state, semantic-hearing state, and effect-consistency review. Case 06 requires all five distinctions.

operability requires an integer total_tokens but has no token evidence state or scope. Case 06 preserves complete Stage B token totals while the Stage A gate preserves calls and cost but not a whole-run token aggregate; using zero or 6587 as a whole-run total would be false custody.
The pressure origin vocabulary does not name the V60 affordance path that produced the protected empathy edge. Using direct_model, mixed, or unknown would weaken lineage precision.

non_claims: not evidence that receipts are useless
